notes: 2 Samuel 22:18 18 He delivered me from my strong enemy, [and] from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
2 Samuel 22:39 39 And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
2 Samuel 22:49 49 And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
